title.zh: 有名交换的正规形恰需要段内不相连可判定
title.en: Normal forms of named exchanges need exactly decided apartness on the stretch

statement.en: With joining symmetric, two arrangements of a finite stretch are connected by commuting unjoined neighbours exactly where they order joined pairs alike; a complete invariant on the stretch exists exactly where apartness of distinct exchanges is decided, the normal form giving one.
statement.zh: 相连对称时，有限段的两个安排经相邻不相连交换互达，恰当它们对相连之对给出同样先后；段上的完整不变量恰在不同交换的不相连可判定时存在，正规形给出一个。

laws.en: On a stretch of m steps from S, an arrangement π with its inverse σ takes each exchange of the stretch to a step of it; the exchanges are named by the numbers π arranges, and a relation joined is read between named exchanges. π′ orients joined pairs as π does where it takes every two joined exchanges of the stretch in the order π takes them.
laws.zh: 在从 S 起 m 步的一段上，安排 π 及其逆 σ 把段中每个交换取到段中的一步；交换以 π 所安排的数命名，关系 joined 在有名交换之间读出。π′ 与 π 对相连之对给出同样先后，是指它对段中每两个相连的交换取 π 所取的先后。

laws.en: A list of commutations commutes by a relation where each swaps two consecutive exchanges the relation does not join, read in the arrangement as it then stands; π′ is reached from (π, σ) where such commutations within the stretch, by joined read through σ, move each exchange i from step π i to step π′ i.
laws.zh: 一列交换依某关系进行，是指每次交换两个该关系不连的相邻交换，关系按当时的安排读出；π′ 由 (π, σ) 达到，是指段内这样一列（依经 σ 读出的 joined）交换把每个交换 i 由步 π i 移到步 π′ i。

laws.en: With joining symmetric, for arrangements (π, σ) and (π′, σ′) of a stretch, π′ is reached from (π, σ) by commuting exchanges not joined exactly where π′ orients every joined pair as π does, with no decision; so being reached is symmetric and transitive.
laws.zh: 相连对称时，对一段的安排 (π, σ) 与 (π′, σ′)，π′ 经交换不相连的交换由 (π, σ) 达到，恰当 π′ 对每一相连之对给出与 π 同样的先后，不需判定；所以可达对称且传递。

laws.en: For a symmetric relation on the steps of a stretch and a renumbering of it, with its inverse, keeping the order the relation gives, some list of commutations within the stretch, each of two consecutive exchanges the relation does not join as it then stands, takes each step where the renumbering does; the renumberings so reached are exactly those keeping that order.
laws.zh: 对一段之步上的对称关系，与保持该关系所给先后的重新编号（及其逆），存在段内的一列交换（每次交换两个按当时状态该关系不连的相邻交换），把每一步取到重新编号所取之处；如此达到的重新编号恰是保持该先后者。

laws.en: Where a world's footprint contains its exchanges, commuting exchanges not joined, each in the world as it then stands, is commuting by the relation the footprint joins; from the world's own arrangement the arrangements reached are those its reorderings within the stretch take, and a renumbering keeps the world's order exactly where it orients joined pairs as the identity does.
laws.zh: 世界的足迹包含其交换时，交换不相连的交换（每次在当时的世界中）即依足迹所连之关系交换；从世界自己的安排出发，所达到的安排恰是它在段内的重排所取者；重新编号保持世界的先后，恰当它对相连之对给出与恒等安排同样的先后。

laws.en: A decision of apartness on a stretch gives, for every two different exchanges of it, true exactly where they are not joined. Given one, the sort fills the steps from S in turn, bringing forward to each, past exchanges apart from it, the least-named exchange free from there; the normal form is where the sort takes each exchange.
laws.zh: 段上的不相连判定，对段中每两个不同的交换，恰在它们不相连处给出 true。给定判定，排序依次填满从 S 起的各步，每步越过与之不相连的交换，把从那里起自由的、名字最小的交换提前；正规形是排序把每个交换所取到之处。

laws.en: Given a decision of apartness, the normal form is an arrangement of the stretch, reached from the given one by commuting exchanges not joined; with joining symmetric, two arrangements, the second orienting joined pairs as the first does, have the same normal form on every exchange of the stretch.
laws.zh: 给定不相连判定，正规形是段的一个安排，由所给安排经交换不相连的交换达到；相连对称时，两个安排（后者对相连之对给出与前者同样的先后）在段的每个交换上有相同的正规形。

laws.en: With joining symmetric and apartness decided on the stretch, two arrangements of it are reached from each other by commuting exchanges not joined exactly where their normal forms agree on every exchange of the stretch.
laws.zh: 相连对称、段上不相连已判定时，段的两个安排经交换不相连的交换互达，恰当它们的正规形在段的每个交换上一致。

laws.en: With joining symmetric and apartness decided, the normal form is its own normal form, and it is lexicographically least among the arrangements reached: where it and one of them hold the same exchanges at the steps before a step of the stretch, its exchange there has a name no greater.
laws.zh: 相连对称、不相连已判定时，正规形是其自身的正规形，并且在所达到的安排中字典序最小：凡它与其中之一在段中某步之前各步持有相同交换，它在该步的交换之名不更大。

laws.en: A complete invariant of the arrangements of a stretch is a function of arrangements, natural-number valued at each exchange of the stretch, agreeing on two there exactly where they are reached from each other; with joining symmetric and apartness decided, the normal form is one.
laws.zh: 一段安排的完整不变量是安排的函数（在段的每个交换上取自然数值），在那里对两个安排一致恰当它们互达；相连对称、不相连已判定时，正规形就是一个。

laws.en: The second way of taking two exchanges i < j of the stretch side by side is reached from the first exactly where the two are not joined; so, with joining symmetric, every complete invariant decides apartness of every two different exchanges of the stretch, by comparing its values on those two ways.
laws.zh: 把段中两个交换 i < j 并排取的第二种方式由第一种达到，恰当二者不相连；所以相连对称时，每个完整不变量都判定段中每两个不同交换的不相连，方法是比较它在这两种方式上的值。

laws.en: With joining symmetric, a complete invariant of the arrangements of a stretch exists exactly where a decision of apartness of its exchanges exists.
laws.zh: 相连对称时，一段安排的完整不变量存在，恰当其交换的不相连判定存在。

laws.en: In Triple, three exchanges on steps 0, 1 and 2, two different ones joined only where they are the first and the last, apartness is decided; taken last to first, the normal form takes the middle, then the last, then the first, and taken first to last it is first to last itself, so the two orders are not reached from each other.
laws.zh: Triple 中，第 0、1、2 步上的三个交换，两个不同的交换只在为首末时相连，不相连已判定；由末到首时正规形取中间、末、首，由首到末时正规形即由首到末本身，所以两个顺序不互达。

laws.en: Where a world's footprint contains its exchanges and apartness of its exchanges is decided on a stretch, normalize commutes the world's exchanges over the stretch, two consecutive exchanges not joined at a time, into the normal form of their arrangement, each exchange named by its step.
laws.zh: 世界的足迹包含其交换、其交换在段上的不相连已判定时，normalize 把世界在段上的交换（每次两个不相连的相邻交换）交换为其安排的正规形，每个交换以其步命名。

laws.en: So normalized, the world meets balance, dissipation, only active giving, only active taking, activity needing support, embodiment and bounded transmission exactly where the world does, and the exchange across one of its steps precedes that across another exactly where the exchanges they came from do in the world.
laws.zh: 如此正规化后，世界恰在原世界满足平衡、耗散、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用、活动需要支持、体现与有界传递处满足它们；它某一步的交换先于另一步的交换，恰当它们所来自的交换在原世界中如此。

laws.en: Where a world's footprint contains its exchanges, two reorderings within a stretch commuting exchanges not joined that take every exchange to the same step take the same exchange across each step and show every relatum alike there; so, apartness decided, any such reordering normalized with each exchange named by the step it held in the world agrees so with the world's normal form.
laws.zh: 世界的足迹包含其交换时，段内交换不相连之交换的两个重排，若把每个交换取到同一步，则在段的每一步取相同交换，并对每个关系项显示相同；所以不相连已判定时，任何这样的重排以每个交换在原世界中所处之步命名再正规化，都与世界的正规形如此一致。

hypotheses.zh: 有限段 S,m，自然数名字，以及每个安排与逆满足 Reindexes；相连关系对称。
hypotheses.en: A finite stretch S,m, natural-number names, and each arrangement and inverse satisfying Reindexes; joining is symmetric.

hypotheses.zh: 正规形用 DecidesApart 判定段中不同交换的不相连；不由此断言相连可判定。关系刻画 rearranges_iff 不用此假设。
hypotheses.en: The normal form uses DecidesApart to decide not being joined for distinct exchanges of the stretch; decidability of joining is not inferred. The relational characterization rearranges_iff needs no such decision.

hypotheses.zh: CompleteInvariant 的值是 Nat，且只比较有限段；世界正规化还要求包含足迹，normalize_reorder 要求独立重排并保留原世界的名字。
hypotheses.en: CompleteInvariant is Nat-valued and compared only on the finite stretch. World normalization additionally requires footprint containment; normalize_reorder requires independent reordering and retains the original naming.

does_not_show.en: The normal form is canonical relative to given natural-number names of the exchanges and to a finite stretch; a normal form read off the exchanges alone, without names, is not given.
does_not_show.zh: 正规形相对于给定的交换自然数名字与有限段才是规范的；不给出不用名字、只由交换读出的正规形。

does_not_show.en: The Foata normal form, of layers of exchanges taken together, and a normal form over an unbounded run are not given.
does_not_show.zh: 不给出 Foata 正规形（同时取的交换之层），也不给出无界运行上的正规形。

does_not_show.en: No correspondence to actual continuous time follows.
does_not_show.zh: 不由此得出与实际连续时间的对应。

detail.zh: Triple：三个交换中首末相连，倒序与正序的正规形不同，不能重排互达。
detail.en: Triple: the first and last of three exchanges are joined; reversing their order changes the normal form and prevents reachability.

correspondence.en: This result reuses the sorting and order of “The order of exchanges as the invariant”, without counting the reused converse as an independent result. Its output is the canonical representative of finite named arrangements and the exact decision boundary, connected to worlds through Footprinted. The reading is AI-authored.
correspondence.zh: 本结果复用“交换的次序作为不变量”的排序与偏序，不重算逆定理为独立成果。产出是有限、有名安排的规范代表与所需判定的精确边界；原世界的关系通过 Footprinted 实例接入。读法由 AI 提出。

detail.zh: 复用相连交换的偏序、有限重新编号、排序与世界重排。
detail.en: Reuses joined-exchange order, finite reindexings, sorting and world reorderings.

output.en: Footprinted, Reindexes, sorts_iff, converse and reorder_premises.

input.zh: 关系形式的安排与世界正规化。

conditions.zh: 有限段；包含足迹；构造规范代表另给不相连判定。
conditions.en: Finite stretch; a containing footprint; canonical representative additionally uses the apartness decision.

detail.zh: 最小足迹固定相连关系的最小读法；其闲置判定不同于本记录的段内不相连判定。
detail.en: The least footprint supplies the least reading of joining; its idleness decision differs from this record’s finite-stretch apartness decision.
